rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an accidental event or result that is unexpected, especially when no intention is specified.

example.english: This power outage was truly accidental.
example.jyutping: nei1 ci3 ting4 din6 zan1 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this for something occurring occasionally or happening by chance, rather than through a planned process.

example.english: We only happened to run into each other on the street; it was an accidental meeting.
example.traditional: 我哋只係偶然喺街度撞到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 ngau5 jin4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zong6 dou2

rows.note: Use this specifically when the event or action was unintentional rather than merely unexpected.

example.english: I made an accidental slip and revealed their secret.
example.traditional: 我係無意中講咗佢個秘密。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 mou4 ji3 zung1 gong2 zo2 keoi5 go3 bei3 mat6
